description: This Java class manages persistence of expectations to the filesystem for the MockServer framework. It serializes expectations to a file when they are updated, handling file locking and logging.

classes.name: ExpectationFileSystemPersistence
classes.description: Handles persistence of expectations to the filesystem, including serialization, file locking, and logging.

methods.name: ExpectationFileSystemPersistence
methods.description: Constructor that initializes persistence settings, creates the file if needed, and registers the listener.

methods.name: updated
methods.description: Handles updates to request matchers by serializing active expectations to the file with proper locking and logging.

methods.name: serialize
methods.description: Serializes a list of expectations into a JSON string.

methods.name: serialize
methods.description: Serializes an array of expectations into a JSON string.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Unregisters the listener from request matchers.
